thread:
incbot: INCIDENT ALERT: elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate (prod, us-east-1). Auto-page -> @oncall_sre. Initial threshold breach at 2026-03-15T03:04:50Z. :rotating_light:

oncall_sre: Acked. I'm looking. Any pre-existing deploys?

devon: No deploys in the last 2 hours from release pipeline. Noted spike aligning with traffic increase from a customer loop.

oncall_sre: Grafana shows 502/504s up ~6x since 03:02. Latency to model-serving (model-nodes-us-east) also up. Opening tracing — seeing many requests with missing span ids.

jia: missing traces = huge pain. Could be sampling dropped or header stripped at edge. I can push a temporary debug sampling rule to 100% for /v1/generate from 03:05-03:35. Want me to?

oncall_sre: Please do. Also enable verbose proxy logs for the gateway for 30m. Need request headers to see request-id propagation.

observability_bot: ACTION: Created trace sampling override -> service: gateway, route: /v1/*, sampling: 100%, window: 30m.

samira: I'm attaching a short hotpatch to propagate x-request-id if missing. It's a tiny lua filter we can enable as an ingress annotation. Should I roll?

oncall_sre: Yes. Apply to the prod ingress as a stopgap. Keep it reversible.

matt: Quick commands I'm running to gather state:
```
# check ingress pods and recent restarts
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=gateway -o wide
# tail logs with request ids
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=gateway --since=15m | grep -E "x-request-id|5.."
```

oncall_sre: Found one oddity: the new edge proxy (edge-proxy-2) doesn't forward x-request-id in some paths. Eng-infra, can we flip traffic off that instance to confirm?

devon: We can route a small % away via our routing policy: set routing weight for edge-proxy-2 -> 0 for 10m. Doing a canary shift now.

observability_bot: ROUTE CHANGE: edge-proxy-2 weight -> 0 (applied).

oncall_sre: After shifting, 502s dropped ~25% in the next minute. Good signal. Keep routing change while we patch.

jia: Sampling override is live. I'm seeing a bunch of traces now, many have hop missing from envoy->upstream. There's also increased upstream 5xx from model-serving pods.

samira: Patching ingress with lua filter now (1min rollout):
```
annotations:
  nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/server-snippet: |
    if ($http_x_request_id = "") {
      set $http_x_request_id $request_id;
    }
```
Rolling...

oncall_sre: Also, enable fallback route to cpu-model-compact variant for high-error requests to keep customers alive while we debug. This is an emergency QoS tradeoff.

devon: Applying fallback: update routing policy -> route /v1/generate to model-variant compact if upstream 502 rate > 1%. Temp rule in place.

observability_bot: FALLBACK POLICY: enabled -> model-variant: compact, threshold: upstream_5xx > 1%, ttl: 20m.

oncall_sre: Monitoring customer impact — CS, please prepare a short blurb for affected customers: likely increased latency for some requests and occasional degraded quality.

matt: Quick Datadog query I used to estimate impacted customers:
```
avg(last_15m):anomalies(avg:gateway.errors{route:/v1/generate,env:prod}, 'basic', 2, direction='both', alert_window='last_5m')
```
Roughly 5 top API keys are generating most of the volume.

samira: Ingress lua patch finished rolling. Re-enabled x-request-id propagation verified by tailing logs — request ids present again.

oncall_sre: Good. Do we still see the 502s from model-serving?

jia: Upstream 5xx persisted but reduced. Traces show a subset of requests hitting a model pod with OOM-kill patterns around the time of request (OOM logs present). I suspect a memory regression on that variant.

devon: If it's an OOM, we can cordon that node and scale the deployment for headroom. I'll scale model-nodes-us-east replica count +2 and cordon the suspect node for investigation.

oncall_sre: Do that and keep fallback policy live. Also add a quick tagging of traces with "mitigation:route-fallback" so we can later slice evals.

observability_bot: TAGS ADDED: traces now include tag mitigation:route-fallback for matched flows.

oncall_sre: Customer impact note: temporarily routed ~12% of traffic to compact variant; we estimate 2000 requests/min affected with 1-2s extra latency avg. CS: send an incident note and offer throttle controls to major customers if requested.

samira: I created a short runbook blurb and temp PR for the ingress patch to revert after 1 hour. PR: https://git.internal/r/ingress/patches/2345 (add comment please).

matt: Metrics trending down. 502 rate back to ~1.2x baseline from 6x. Will keep the debug sampling on for another 10m, then roll back to 5% if steady.

oncall_sre: I'll hand off to daytime oncall at 04:15. Summary for handoff: 1) Root cause suspected memory regression in a model-serving pod causing upstream 5xx 2) Stopgaps applied: ingress x-request-id propagation patch, route shift off edge-proxy-2, fallback model-variant enabled, scaled model replicas +2 3) Observability: sampling override and temporary trace tags in place 4) Customer impact: ~2000 rps routed to compact variant, expected minor quality degradation 5) Next steps: investigate model pod OOMs, revert routing when stable.

devon: Noted. Leaving routing change and fallback in place until investigation complete.

jia: I'll leave sampling override for 10 more minutes and then reduce to 5% unless errors resurge.

observability_bot: HANDOFF: oncall_sre -> daytime_oncall at 3134568350. Documentation: /incidents/3134567890/notes.

oncall_sre: Handoff done. If daytime_oncall needs help, ping me in this thread. :white_check_mark:
